categories.main_business_segments: Goldwind operates primarily in three segments: Wind Turbine Generator (WTG) Manufacturing and Sales, Wind Power Services, and Wind Farm Investment and Development. Additionally, it engages in water treatment operations. These segments cover the full wind power industry value chain, from R&D and manufacturing of turbines to wind farm development, operation, and post-warranty services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced wind turbine technologies with multiple product platforms (GWHV11, GWHV12, GWHV15, GWHV17, GWHV20, GWHV21) covering onshore, offshore, and overseas markets. It emphasizes R&D with over 3,000 staff, modular design, integrated drive trains, and innovations in blade length, tower height, and floating wind turbine systems. Goldwind also develops wind resource assessment software (GoldFoam 3.0) and holds numerous patents and certifications, including DNV and IEC standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Goldwind serves wind power project developers, operators, and asset managers globally. Its customers include domestic and international wind farm operators, with a focus on large-scale onshore and offshore wind projects. The company also provides services to industrial parks and enterprises for energy and carbon management. Its markets span six continents, including China, North America, Europe, Asia, South America, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: Goldwind operates mainly in China, with significant international presence across 47 countries on six continents. Key overseas markets include North America, Oceania, Europe, South America, and Africa. It has manufacturing bases in China, Brazil, and Germany, and regional R&D and solution centers worldwide. The company’s wind farms and assets are distributed across 22 Chinese provinces and multiple international locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Goldwind operates across the upstream and midstream segments of the wind power supply chain, including R&D, manufacturing of wind turbine generators and components, and downstream services such as wind farm development, operation, and maintenance. It also provides comprehensive wind power services and asset management, positioning itself as an integrated solution provider in the wind power industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-led, efficiency-driven, and high-quality growth. R&D focuses on large-capacity turbines, modular designs, offshore and deep-sea wind technologies, floating wind systems, hybrid towers, and energy storage solutions. Goldwind invests in digitalization, AI-enhanced power prediction, unmanned wind farm operations, and carbon management technologies. It actively participates in international standard-setting and aims to expand its global footprint and new business areas like green chemicals and hydrogen production.
categories.revenue_model: Goldwind generates revenue primarily through sales of wind turbine generators and components, post-warranty wind power services including asset management and construction, and electricity generation from its wind farms. Additional revenue streams include water treatment operations and finance lease services. The company also benefits from government grants and gains from disposal of equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Goldwind is a market leader in China and globally, ranking first in domestic new wind power installations for 14 consecutive years and first globally for 3 consecutive years. It holds a 22% domestic market share and 15.9% global market share. The company competes with other major wind turbine manufacturers and renewable energy solution providers, leveraging its advanced technology, comprehensive solutions, and global expansion to maintain leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Goldwind reported operating revenue of RMB 56.52 billion, a 12.48% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to owners of RMB 1.86 billion, up 39.78%. Total assets reached RMB 155.22 billion, with net assets of RMB 40.43 billion. The company’s order backlog grew 55.93% YoY to 47.4 GW. It employs over 11,000 staff and maintains a strong financial position with diversified revenue streams and ongoing capital investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Goldwind emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and efficient wind turbine products with independent intellectual property rights and advanced technology platforms tailored for diverse environments. It offers comprehensive wind power solutions across the value chain, including innovative digital services, unmanned wind farm operations, and integrated energy storage. Its global presence, strong R&D capabilities, and leadership in standard-setting differentiate it as a trusted strategic partner in clean energy.
